ios.desc:
Aurora Player is a unique media player application for Apple Vision Pro. It is a multiform video player that shows a realistic glow effect around the player that matches the content of the video. It is like an LED strip light placed around the video border. You can resize the video player to create a home theater experience in your living room and easily reposition it anywhere within your space. This has never been seen and done before on the VisionOS platform. And you will be blown away by this vivid effect on all your favorite videos.

This multimedia player supports the following file types:
Aurora Player supports various file types, including avi, m4v, mov, mp4, mpeg, mpg, and m3u8 (the playlist containing video and subtitles), ensuring compatibility with your diverse multimedia library.

Moreover, Aurora Player offers the option to play your YouTube videos. It is the ideal tool and the A-plus for students, video lovers, musical lovers, YouTube watchers, filmmakers, content creators, and cinema fans.

Turn Off the Lights for Safari
Inspired by the popular browser extension Turn Off the Lights. This extension dims everything in the background, so you can enjoy the video you are watching. And include the Atmosphere Lighting feature for a realistic glow effect on HTML5 videos.

Experience the premium quality of Apple Vision Pro with these outstanding features:
◆ Enjoy Spatial Audio and Dolby Atmos while watching your videos
◆ Native user interface for controlling playback, allowing users to play, pause, and seek
◆ Option to loop the video endlessly, rewind 10 seconds backward, fast forward 10 seconds, and share button
◆ Drag and drop your movie files onto the video player
◆ Customize the glow around the player with realistic or solid colors
◆ Access YouTube videos directly within the app, with the YouTube Search and YouTube Trending tab
◆ Easily open and play local videos from your device
◆ Seamlessly browse your media library, including iCloud Drive support and server SMB integration for remote file access
◆ Stream content from server URLs directly into the video player
◆ Easily load your SRT and VTT subtitle files seamlessly into the video player
◆ Select your preferred audio language channel within the video player for convenient access to the translated version
◆ Choose one of the Customizable Immersive Spaces:
+ Star: Get lost in the sparkling beauty of a starry night sky
+ Rain: Feel the soothing rhythm of raindrops falling around you
+ Snow: Embrac
